o: Sort countries by gold desc, then silver desc, then bronze desc, then name ascending lexicographically. A single ORDER BY clause expresses all four keys. In the example, China precedes USA only by name after full medal ties.
k: Multi-key ORDER BY with mixed directions handles the entire specification.
Lexicographic string ordering is the default for VARCHAR comparison.

a.i: List the four sort keys with appropriate directions; SQL applies them lexicographically as a composite comparator.
s: Finally country ASC for the name tie-break.

c.python:
-- SQL (MySQL)
SELECT country, gold_medals, silver_medals, bronze_medals
FROM Olympic
ORDER BY gold_medals DESC, silver_medals DESC, bronze_medals DESC, country ASC;
